items.headline: Microsoft Releases Preliminary Report on Recent 365 Service Outage
items.summary: Microsoft issued a preliminary post-incident report attributing the recent Microsoft 365 service disruption to a latent software defect and network capacity issues.

items.headline: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Officer Sells $8.37 Million in Common Stock
items.summary: Charles F. Wagner Jr., an officer at Vertex Pharmaceuticals, sold 15,300 shares of common stock valued at approximately $8.37 million.

items.headline: Teamsters Organize Rally for Terminated Amazon Delivery Drivers in New York City
items.summary: The Teamsters union is organizing a rally to support 200 delivery drivers who were dismissed after Amazon terminated its contract with their third-party employer.

items.headline: Instagram Launches Integration for Amazon Affiliate Links
items.summary: Instagram has introduced a new feature allowing creators to directly integrate Amazon affiliate links into Reels and feed posts.

items.headline: BlackRock Reports Change in Voting Rights in Smiths Group
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. disclosed a reduction in its total voting rights in Smiths Group, moving from 12.97% to 12.61%.

items.headline: BlackRock Investment Institute Warns of Potential AI Buildout Slowdown Impact
items.summary: Jean Boivin, head of the BlackRock Investment Institute, highlighted the risk that a deceleration in AI infrastructure investment could have material consequences for U.S. economic growth.

items.headline: Amnesty International Reports Continued Labor Issues at Amazon Saudi Arabia Facilities
items.summary: Amnesty International has alleged that migrant workers at Amazon facilities in Saudi Arabia continue to face exploitation, including misleading recruitment practices and wage issues.

items.headline: Court Grants Intervention in Broadcom and VMware Legal Case
items.summary: The President of the Fourth Chamber of the General Court has granted the ACC leave to intervene in support of Broadcom and VMware in Case T-280/26.

items.headline: NVIDIA Announces Quantum Computing Collaborations with IBM and Fermilab
items.summary: NVIDIA is partnering with IBM and the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to advance quantum computing research, including a new modular codesign platform and a high-speed decoding algorithm.

items.headline: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron for Science Platform
items.summary: NVIDIA launched 'NVIDIA Nemotron for Science,' a new platform designed to help researchers build specialized AI agents for scientific discovery, including a new chemistry dataset.

items.headline: NVIDIA Launches Vera CPU Platform for High-Performance Computing
items.summary: NVIDIA announced the 'NVIDIA Vera CPU' rack-scale platform, its first custom data center CPU designed for high-performance scientific modeling and simulation.

items.headline: Thread AI Joins Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program
items.summary: Thread AI has been accepted into the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program, providing the company with access to Azure AI models and enterprise-grade support.

items.headline: Microsoft Addresses Recent 365 Service Disruption
items.summary: Microsoft has implemented new service health check methods and automated recovery systems following a global disruption to its 365 services that occurred between November 12 and 14, 2026.

items.headline: TD Cowen Adjusts Broadcom Price Target to $425 From $475
items.summary: TD Cowen has revised its price target for Broadcom Inc. to $425, down from the previous target of $475.

items.headline: Nanoform Finland Partners with CDMO for Biologics Manufacturing
items.summary: Nanoform Finland has entered into a cooperation agreement with a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) to support the production of biologics.

items.headline: Enlivex Announces $7.5 Million Registered Direct Offering
items.summary: Enlivex Ltd. has entered into a securities purchase agreement for a registered direct offering of ordinary shares and warrants totaling $7.5 million.

items.headline: Cyabra Announces $40 Million Investment Agreement and Debt Cancellation
items.summary: Cyabra, Inc. has entered into an investment agreement for up to $40 million in new capital over three years and the cancellation of approximately $3 million in outstanding debt.

items.headline: Pluri CEO Issues Letter to Shareholders on Commercial Strategy
items.summary: Pluri Inc. President and CEO Yaky Yanay released a letter to shareholders outlining the company's focused commercial strategy and providing updates on recent strategic and financial developments.

items.headline: Oriola CEO to Step Down in March 2027
items.summary: Oriola Corporation has announced that its Chief Executive Officer will step down from the position in March 2027.

items.headline: MediWound Executives and Director Increase Shareholdings via Warrant Exercises
items.summary: MediWound's CEO, Chairman, and a director increased their equity stakes by exercising existing warrants ahead of their expiration.

items.headline: MediWound to Host Virtual Key Opinion Leader Event on EscharEx®
items.summary: MediWound announced it will host a virtual Key Opinion Leader (KOL) event on December 2, 2026, to discuss the clinical and commercial outlook for its investigational biologic, EscharEx®.

items.headline: SuperCom Chairman Purchases 19,600 Ordinary Shares and Plans to Purchase Up to 150,000 Shares in Total
items.summary: SuperCom Ltd. announced that its Chairman, Arie Trabelsi, purchased 19,600 ordinary shares in the open market and intends to acquire up to 150,000 shares in total.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs Analyst Adjusts Innoviz Technologies Price Target
items.summary: Goldman Sachs analyst Mark Delaney maintained a 'Neutral' rating on Innoviz Technologies while lowering the price target from $0.40 to $0.20.

items.headline: Beyond Oil Ltd. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Beyond Oil Ltd. announced record quarterly revenue of US$1.4 million for the third quarter of 2026, marking its eighth consecutive quarter of sequential growth.

items.headline: Namib Minerals Reports Strong Initial Operating Leverage From Expanded How Mine Mill
items.summary: Namib Minerals announced that its recently commissioned expanded milling plant at How Mine has achieved high availability and significantly increased production volumes in October 2026.

items.headline: Mobilicom Announces Participation in Upcoming Industry and Investor Conferences
items.summary: Mobilicom Limited announced its participation in three upcoming industry and investor conferences scheduled for November and December 2026, including the Loitering Munitions UK conference.

items.headline: Mobilicom to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Mobilicom Limited announced it will release its financial and operational results for the third quarter of 2026 on November 30, 2026.

items.headline: Duke Robotics Corp. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Duke Robotics Corp. announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, highlighting increased R&D and administrative expenses alongside a net loss of $813,000.

items.headline: Eocene and Barcode Nanotech Advance Development of Tumor-Targeting Aramchol Formulation

items.headline: Betolar Plc to Present at Small Cap Growth Virtual Investor Conference
items.summary: Betolar Plc is scheduled to participate in the Small Cap Growth Virtual Investor Conference, taking place on November 18-19, 2026.

items.headline: Dynagas LNG Partners LP Announces Date for the Release of the Third Quarter and Nine Months 2026 Results
items.summary: Dynagas LNG Partners LP has scheduled the release of its financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, for November 20, 2026.

items.headline: Nanox to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 25, 2026
items.summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. announced it will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 25, 2026.

items.headline: TempraMed Signs Exclusive Distribution Agreement with DayMed Qatar
items.summary: TempraMed Technologies Ltd. has entered into a three-year exclusive distribution agreement with DayMed Trading to commercialize its temperature-protection products in Qatar.

items.headline: Euroholdings Ltd. Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026

items.headline: SciSparc Appoints Prof. Jacob Nagel to Scientific Advisory Board for AI and Cybersecurity
items.summary: SciSparc Ltd. has appointed Prof. Jacob Nagel, a renowned expert in AI, advanced technologies, and cybersecurity, to its Scientific Advisory Board.

items.headline: Nasus Pharma Appoints Nir Sassi as Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: Nasus Pharma Ltd. has appointed Nir Sassi as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective November 11, 2026.

items.headline: Globus Maritime Limited Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026

items.headline: QTREX Quantum Ltd. Acquires Global Inkjet Systems Limited
items.summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd. has acquired Global Inkjet Systems Limited from Nano Dimension Ltd. for $16 million in a transaction aimed at scaling quantum interconnect production.

items.headline: Similarweb Scheduled to Report Q3 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Similarweb Ltd. is scheduled to release its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 before the market opens on November 17, 2026.

items.headline: Odysight.ai Reports Financial Results for the Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026
items.summary: Odysight.ai announced its financial results for the first nine months of 2026, reporting $0.9 million in revenue and providing a business update on its backlog and future outlook.
